dati.parola_regola: Expanding if at least 4 of 6 gauges expanded over 30 days, Contracting if at least 4 contracted, otherwise Mixed; a gauge that is not available counts for neither side

blocchi.misura: open interest on Binance perpetuals of 45 major tokens, as a share of their market value
blocchi.nota: open interest history starts 2026-08-12: the 90-day window is not available before 2026-11-12

valori.etichetta: Open interest as a share of market value, across 45 tokens
Funding rate per 8 hours, weighted by open interest
valori.nota: accessory reading: it does not enter the word of the dashboard

blocchi.misura: total fees paid to protocols and total DEX volume, 30-day sums through 2026-10-06
net deposits with token prices held constant, summed over the protocols with a token breakdown
blocchi.nota: token breakdown history starts 2026-06-01; a token deposited twice (a staked token used as collateral) counts twice, as in the source

valori.etichetta: Net deposits over 30 days, token prices held constant

blocchi.misura: share of all protocol fees taken by launchpads and memecoin apps (Launchpad, Meme), last day excluded
blocchi.nota_finestre: a share of fees in these two categories only, not a measure of all speculation; the current window leaves out the last 24 hours (still provisional at the source), so it covers 29 (or 6) days against 30 (or 7) in the window before: both are shares, not sums
blocchi.nota: from the nightly fee table stored since 2026-09-09: the 90-day window is not available

valori.etichetta: Share of protocol fees taken by launchpads and memecoin apps, 30 days

blocchi.misura: macro reading from a separate macro dashboard
blocchi.regola: the macro reading is a composite of leading macro indicators; it is compared with its level 30 days earlier: higher by 0.5 or more is expanding, lower by 0.5 or more is contracting, in between is flat
blocchi.nota: the composite history starts on 2026-09-12: the comparison covers the 26 days available, not 30

each issuer row carries its own date (column 'As of'); Robinhood Chain values are as of the dashboard day, not of the closed week; tokenized-stock issuers: market value by issuer from CoinGecko categories, collected since 2 Oct 2026, so 30-day comparisons start in November; Robinhood Chain history starts 7 Jul 2026

frasi.testo: Crypto state: Expanding since 28 Sep 2026; 5 of 6 gauges expanded over 30 days
Stablecoin supply rose 1.3% in 30 days, to $314.5B
Total fees rose 17% in 30 days; DEX volume rose 18%
Net deposits across DeFi, with the price effect removed, were $3.84B in 30 days
Open interest was 0.78% of market value across 45 tokens, down from 0.79% 30 days earlier
Memecoins and launchpads took 10% of all fees in 30 days, up from 8.4%
